subject.title: fix(web): provider caches split one URL across case-only variants

question: Should `canonicalizeUrlCacheDimension` become a supported public export from both provider web plugin-SDK barrels after the cache-hit metadata regression is repaired?
rationale: The implementation needs a shared core-to-plugin seam, but adding a named plugin-SDK helper is a durable external contract rather than a private refactor.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK seam
options.body: Keep the additive export after fixing the Firecrawl cache-hit metadata behavior and documenting its URL-only cache-key purpose in the PR evidence.

options.title: Choose a different SDK boundary
options.body: Ask for a more general existing or newly designed provider utility if maintainers do not want this helper name and behavior to become public API.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the additive export after fixing the Firecrawl cache-hit metadata behavior and documenting its URL-only cache-key purpose in the PR evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, and the outstanding choice is specifically whether to accept the new public plugin-SDK contract.
